prompt.description: Configuration for the prompt; `settings` and `label` are not read

teacherInstructions.description: Configuration for the teacher instructions; `settings` and `label` are not read

maxAnswerChoices.description: The most choices `validate()` accepts; unset allows any number

description: Config Object for `@pie-element/mc-populated-blank`. The author view is a placeholder that reads none of it; `validate()` reads the choice counts and the `required` flags.

settings.description: Indicates if the item has to be displayed in the Settings Panel

label.description: Indicates the label for the item that has to be displayed in the Settings Panel

required.description: Indicates if the item is required and the value cannot be empty

McpbFieldConfigure.description: A Settings Panel control for an editable field.
